<p>Tan also shared his personal workflow, which he calls the "Conductor Pattern." This involves running 10-15 parallel Claude code sessions simultaneously, each in its own isolated workspace. Tan noted that this approach helps manage the complexity of AI development by keeping different workflows separate and manageable.</p>
